scope: V2 Wide development evidence only; does not alter immutable P2 V1 evidence

defect.description: The V2 comparison/Dev-2 arXiv route extracted arXiv-looking identifiers by regex over the complete Atom response body. An Atom entry summary or other feed metadata may contain an arXiv identifier that is not the identity of a returned result entry. Some max_results=20 calls consequently exposed more than 20 identifiers to the candidate pool.
defect.observed_counterexample: Dev-2 traces contain arXiv calls configured for max_results=20 with returned_ids counts above 20.
defect.required_fix: Parse only Atom entry identities using the repository arXiv parser; normalize each returned entry identity once; assert returned scorer IDs do not exceed max_results.

next_step: Prospectively freeze and execute one corrected acquisition-development comparison before any fresh confirmation.
